body:
How the CF challenge works

Cloudflare injects a script that sets window._cf_chl_opt with fields like cvId and cRay. Detectors should look for this object to recognize a challenge page.
note: A normal allowed article that merely QUOTES the literal token window._cf_chl_opt in prose, served behind Cloudflare. The detector must NOT flag it: there is no challenge assignment and status is 200. FALSE POSITIVE found by adversarial review (fp-specialist, HIGH).
